# Research log: input search (generated by `tools/research_log.py` from the search ledgers)

Rules: `bench/PROTOCOL.md` section 6b. Every number here is a VALIDATION number (the 90 days before each fold's training end,
trained-on symbols). Test folds were not read by the search. Objective = mean over hourly h 1 / 6 / 24 and daily h 1 / 5 of
asset-equal sPL / sqrt(h), four folds; lower is better. Stages: `s1` = 500 steps on fold F3, `s2` = 1,500 steps on F1 + F3,
`full` = 1,500 steps on all four folds, then the paired block-bootstrap comparison with the incumbent. Promotion needs the 95 %
interval of the improvement above zero at two or more of the five (task, horizon) pairs and significantly worse at none.
All configs: size s (4 layers x 128), patch 16, same seed and the same training windows per fold, so differences come from inputs.

Wave 1 searched inputs available from the hourly archive for all 350 pool symbols. Wave 2 added inputs that need the 5-minute
archive (intra-hour realised variance and its downside share) plus peer and BTC-range inputs; it uses the 64 evaluation symbols
only (trained on the 47 seen ones), so its incumbent was retrained in that setting first and comparisons stay paired.

Wave 3 changed the objective to the validation rank IC of the median (mean over the five task-horizon pairs; the "validation
objective" column is minus that IC) and trained on grouped batches (32 origins x 32 symbols) so a within-origin correlation
loss on the median could be added (`ic10`, `ic30` = weight 0.1 / 0.3). Paired improvements in wave 3 are IC points x 100.
The promoted wave-3 config was then scored once on the unseen folds and did not confirm (`agent/LEADERBOARD.md`).

## Wave 4: 24 h ranking objective under the fixed validation set-up (`agent/PREREG-24H.md`, 2026-11-17)

Set-up (PLAN item 2): the incumbent is `ohlc+cal` trained on i.i.d. windows as in wave 1. Every arm uses its final EMA weights (no
checkpoint selection on the compared metric) and two seeds (0, 1); per-origin series are averaged over the seeds. Validation = the four
folds' 90-day validation windows, seen symbols, every hourly origin (8,544 origins pooled). L/S = top fifth minus bottom fifth by the
24 h median, net = gross - 2 x 4 bp. 0.73 GPU-hours, 10 arm-seeds x 4 folds x 1,500 steps. `train/rank24.py`, outputs in `runs-agent/r24/`.

overlapping 5-hour-stride 24 h holds and assumes shorting; at taker costs (20 bp) every model is negative.

### Does it add to the bots' trend signal (ALGOS pooled harness, 14 universes, 36 coins, daily 00:00 UTC, 2023-01 .. 2026-10)

Correlation (per-day Spearman, mean over 19,484 universe-days, 7-day block intervals):

| forecast | rho with trend score | IC vs next-day return | trend score IC |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mkt+r24` | -0.136 [-0.154, -0.116] | +0.070 [+0.059, +0.083] | -0.001 [-0.015, +0.013] |
| `inc` | -0.169 [-0.185, -0.155] | +0.028 [+0.015, +0.041] | |
| registered `ohlc+cal` | -0.161 [-0.180, -0.140] | +0.035 [+0.023, +0.048] | |

Blend arm (held weights x (1 + r), r = centred forecast rank, gross kept), pooled paired test vs `base` on the harness's 3,000-config family:

| forecast | cost | mean d Sharpe [95 %] | share > 0 | d bp/day | 10 placebo draws (shuffled ranks) | class |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mkt+r24` | c7 | -0.086 [-0.185, +0.014] | 30 % | -1.17 [-2.32, -0.20] | -0.214 .. -0.136 | NEUTRAL |
| `mkt+r24` | c10 | -0.118 [-0.217, -0.016] | 24 % | -1.39 [-2.54, -0.41] | -0.251 .. -0.173 | NEUTRAL (-) |
| `inc` | c7 / c10 | -0.244 / -0.278 (intervals below 0) | 7 % / 5 % | -2.3 / -2.5 | not run | HARMFUL |

Reading: the 24 h forecast is mildly anti-correlated with the trend score and carries ranking information the trend score lacks (the
trend score itself has no next-day IC). The `mkt+r24` blend beats all 10 random-rank placebos by about +0.09 Sharpe, i.e. the
information is real, but daily re-tilting costs more than it earns: the blend is not better than the plain trend book. Not an
integration candidate in this form; research tier only (Binance Vision NC data).

## Wave 4b: the frozen forecast only where the bots already trade (`agent/PREREG-GATE.md`, 2026-11-17)

ALGOS pooled harness, 14 universes, 3,000-config family, 2023-01 .. 2026-10, frozen `mkt+r24` (no retraining). Placebo = 10 draws of
day-wise shuffled forecast ranks through the same form. Turnover = median over universes of the median per-config change vs base.
Ruin = M11 median worst dd60 (S1-S5), base -> form. `tools/r24gate.py`, outputs `runs-agent/r24/gate/`.

| form | cost | mean d Sharpe [95 %] | share > 0 | d bp/day | years + (2023-26 d Sharpe) | placebo range | turnover | ruin dd60 | class |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (a) `gt` tilt on trade days | c7 | +0.145 [+0.015, +0.264] | 85 % | -0.62 [-2.75, +1.05] | 4/4 (+0.12 +0.06 +0.22 +0.26) | -0.008 .. +0.037 | -4.9 % | 41.1 -> 24.3 | INNOVATION |
| (a) `gt` | c10 | +0.141 [+0.011, +0.261] | 84 % | -0.61 [-2.74, +1.07] | 4/4 | -0.012 .. +0.033 | -4.9 % | 41.2 -> 24.6 | INNOVATION |
| (b) `ge` entry gate | c7 | -0.004 [-0.032, +0.026] | 45 % | -0.14 | 2/4 | -0.008 .. +0.003 | -0.4 % | 41.1 -> 40.9 | NEUTRAL |
| (b) `ge` | c10 | -0.004 [-0.032, +0.026] | 45 % | -0.14 | 2/4 | -0.008 .. +0.003 | -0.4 % | 41.2 -> 41.2 | NEUTRAL |
| (c) `gx` causal exit hint | c7 | +0.128 [-0.433, +0.636] | 70 % | -2.81 [-8.09, +1.65] | 2/4 | +0.027 .. +0.176 | -15.3 % | 41.1 -> 4.6 | NEUTRAL |
| (c) `gx` | c10 | +0.124 [-0.439, +0.633] | 69 % | -2.74 | 2/4 | +0.021 .. +0.170 | -15.3 % | 41.2 -> 4.7 | NEUTRAL |

Reading:
- (a) passes every pre-registered condition at both costs. The ranking information is worth +0.11 Sharpe over the shuffled-rank
  placebo, and the form cuts turnover. Caveat: the form only scales rows down (gross never above base), so on the live config gross
  drops 0.83 -> 0.74. That is why d bp/day is slightly negative and why the ruin view improves; the placebo has the same mechanics
  and gains about 0. One of three forms, so this is a strong lead, not a finding. Nothing staged; the weights are research tier.
- (b) changes 15 % of days and nothing else; delayed entries cost and save about the same.
- (c) halves held coin-days (stays flat until the base exit). Its d Sharpe is no better than its placebo (+0.03 .. +0.18), so the
  effect is de-risking, not the forecast.
- Next for (a): a gross-matched version (re-gross to the base row only when the tilt lowers gross, so the risk is equal) as a
  confirmation on the post-October data and on the 16 SIGNAL universes R9-R24, registered before running.

## Wave 4f: gearing of the confirmed tilt (`agent/PREREG-REGEAR.md`, 2026-11-18)

Question: `gt` only scales rows down (gross 0.83 -> 0.74 on the Binance settings), so at what constant multiplier k of the producer's
risk budget does it carry the risk of the untilted base, and what CAGR does that buy. k multiplies pv and cap (and the bear rows) before
the tilt, as the producer would with `--pvt --cap --pvt-bear --cap-bear` x k; the tilt then acts on the k-scaled book, so its timing is
kept (unlike `gtr`). Arms: `gt` at k 1.00 .. 1.30, pure gearing (base at k 0.85 .. 1.30, no tilt), both paired with base k 1. 30
universes (14 lead + R9-R24) x 3,003 configurations, c7 / c10, 2023-01 .. 2026-10, plus the two live configurations on M11.
`tools/r24regear.py`, outputs `runs-agent/regear/{regear,live,gross}.json`. A gearing calibration in sample on data already used to
select and confirm `gt`: no placebo, no new significance claim.

Identity (k = 1 reproduces the stored `gt` run bit-for-bit): `al.summarize` arrays and turnover equal to the wave 4c resume cache on
16/16 universes at both costs; pooled statistics equal to `gate/gate_gt.json` (13 keys and its ruin row) and `confirm/gate_gt.json`
(14 keys); the Binance-settings base re-simulated alone equals the stored base cell. Mean target gross on the Binance settings 0.830 ->
0.739 at k 1, as the producer reports.

Pick (registered rule: largest grid k, contiguous from 1.00, at which the pooled median paired worst-month and 60-day drawdown are
both <= 0 and both live configurations have worst month and 60-day drawdown not above their base, at c7 and c10): **k* = 1.10**.
- Pooled alone passes on the whole grid (k 1.30: worst month -0.5, 60-day DD -0.5; nothing is extrapolated beyond it). Volatility
  matches base at k 1.30 (ratio 1.000). Not in the rule: median maxDD passes base between 1.25 and 1.30, and the M11 ruin view
  P(DD > 60 %) between 1.20 and 1.25 (39.4 -> 43.1 against 41.1).
- The Binance settings pass on the whole grid. The binding constraint is the KuCoin settings: worst month +0.18 points above its
  base at k 1.15 (10.8 against 10.6 %), 60-day DD above it from 1.20 (+0.8 to +1.3). One path; KuCoin runs the lower budget (pv .20)
  with a 10.6 % worst month in this window, so there is little room. Its k 1.25 target book is the Binance k 1.00 one (cooldown 96 / 72 h).
- The owner's 30 % worst-month limit is nowhere near binding in this window (`gt` live rows 6.8 - 11.4 % at every k); 2020-22 is not in
  it (no forecast), where the untilted Binance settings had 23.1 % (FRONTIER).

What k* = 1.10 buys (pooled, c7 / c10): median d CAGR +0.9 / +0.9 against -1.0 / -0.9 at k 1 (mean +0.77 [-7.58, +5.23]; the interval
includes zero at every k), d Sharpe +0.135 [+0.028, +0.242] / +0.131 [+0.024, +0.238], volatility 0.88 x base, worst month -1.6, 21-day
DD -1.8, 60-day DD -2.6, maxDD -2.9, ruin 41.1 -> 33.0 %, turnover +3.9 % (pure gearing at the same k: +10.3 %), 19/30 universes with
higher median CAGR (12/30 at k 1), 49 % of cells with higher CAGR at not-higher worst month. Lead and R9-R24 agree (d CAGR +0.91 / +0.97,
worst month -1.76 / -1.51). So k* gives back the tilt's CAGR cost and a little more while keeping about two thirds of its drawdown and
volatility reduction (half of it on the ruin view).

Tilt against pure gearing:
- Same gearing, no tilt (base k 1.10): d CAGR +1.8 but Sharpe -0.007, worst month +0.7, 60-day DD +1.2, maxDD +2.0, ruin 49.1 %.
- At equal risk the tilt is worth about +4 to +5.5 CAGR points, flat in k: +5.2 .. +5.7 at equal worst month and +4.7 .. +5.1 at equal
  60-day DD (k 1.20 - 1.30, where the match lies inside the control grid), +3.5 .. +3.8 at equal maxDD and +3.7 .. +4.3 at equal volatility
  (k 1.10 - 1.30). At k* itself the worst-month and 60-day matches lie below the control grid: `gt` k 1.10 has lower drawdowns than base
  k 0.85 (worst month -1.61 against -1.13, 60-day -2.57 against -1.96) with +0.9 against -3.1 CAGR, i.e. at least +4.0.
- Against `gtr` (+0.065, not separated): at the volatility-matched k 1.30 the constant multiplier keeps d Sharpe +0.113 [+0.009, +0.221]
  and d CAGR +4.3 (mean +4.11 [-0.42, +8.84]).

Production statement for k* = 1.10 (no deploy done; with the tilt on, never without it):
- Binance, job `binancegomojo/live_trader` env (the `stopwatch` job carries copies of the same four): `BGM_TREND_PVT` 0.25 -> 0.275,
  `BGM_TREND_CAP` 1.875 -> 2.0625, `BGM_TREND_PVT_BEAR` 0.1875 -> 0.20625, `BGM_TREND_CAP_BEAR` 1.5625 -> 1.71875; then re-run
  `deploy/staged/fcast-tilt/jobs.py on-binance`, because `BGM_TREND_PRODUCER` embeds `--pvt --cap --pvt-bear --cap-bear` (and the
  `--config` label) from that env and a stale copy would keep k = 1.
- KuCoin, job `bitbankkucoinmojo/trend_producer` argv: `--pvt` 0.20 -> 0.22, `--cap` 1.5 -> 1.65, `--pvt-bear` 0.15 -> 0.165,
  `--cap-bear` 1.25 -> 1.375 (label `--config trend_m11_sel10_pv0.22_g1.65_cov1`).
- Feasibility, Binance: live-exec's default `--min-margin-level 2.0` (the trader script does not pass one) stops increases at gross
  2.0. At k 1.10 the cap is 2.0625: the tilted target row is above 2.0 on 17 of 1,411 window days (32 over the whole history) by at
  most 0.06 of equity, so those days are under-filled by <= 3 % of the book; no block. Exact tracking needs the floor at 1.94 (a script
  change). k <= 1.066 needs nothing; k 1.30 (cap 2.44, margin level 1.70, 79 days above 2.0) needs the floor lowered (live-check
  blocks below 1.5). Borrow is needed on 30 % of days as today (430 against 452); USDT borrow has been available (4.6 - 5.7 %/yr logged,
  10 % modelled) but an empty pool (-3045) leaves the book at gross <= 1, the safe side.
- Feasibility, KuCoin: bkm clips gross at `-lev 3`, blocks new exposure above debt ratio 0.6 (gross 2.5) and accepts file weights in
  [0, 3]; the producer cap is 1.65 at k 1.10 and 1.95 at k 1.30. No change needed at any grid k.
- Fallback risk: with k > 1 a run that falls back to plain targets (malformed file, model mismatch, no cached copy) trades base k 1.10,
  the pure-gearing arm (worst month +0.7, ruin 41 -> 49 %), until the file is good again.

Caveats: in-sample calibration over 46 months; the two live rows are single paths (the tilt's CAGR cost at k 1 is -1.5 points on the
Binance settings and -9.8 on the KuCoin settings, against a pooled median of -1.0; at k 1.10 the KuCoin row is still 6.7 below its
base, interval [-21.5, +3.1], and reaches base CAGR near 1.15 - 1.20). Turnover is the sim total (the gearing changes the whole
simulated history). The forward check is the February 2027 scoring.

**Verdict by the registered rule: k 1.20 confirmed.** At k 1.20, both costs: (risk) median paired worst month -0.9, 60-day DD -1.3,
maxDD -0.3, ruin 28.2 against 32.6 (c10 28.5 against 33.7); (gain) mean d CAGR +1.07 / +0.98 and 13 / 12 of 16 universes with median
CAGR up at median worst month not up (10 needed). On the same footing k 1.10 passes risk but not gain (median d CAGR -0.4, 6 of 16
universes: on these universes 1.10 does not yet give back the tilt's CAGR cost of -2.1), and k 1.30 fails risk (maxDD +1.3, ruin 33.6
against 32.6). What the rule does not show:
- The gain is a point estimate. Mean d CAGR at 1.20 is +1.07 [-4.35, +5.29] (calibration: +2.5 [-3.4, +6.3]); the median is +1.0
  against +2.7 in wave 4f.
- maxDD is at base level, not below it: median -0.3, and only 8 of 16 universes have a median maxDD not above base. Worst month
  (16/16), 60-day DD (15/16) and the ruin view (15 / 14 of 16) are clearly below.
- The frozen tilt itself (k 1) on these universes: mean d Sharpe +0.111 [-0.019, +0.242] at c7, +0.108 [-0.023, +0.240] at c10,
  Sharpe up in 76 % of configurations, 15/16 universes, 4/4 years (+0.01, +0.19, +0.16, +0.16), turnover -6.0 %. Same sign and about
  three quarters of the size of waves 4b / 4c (+0.145, +0.141), but the interval includes zero and the mean is above the sign
  placebo's p95 (+0.079) only; `al.klass` with the sign placebo alone gives NEUTRAL (no shuffled-rank placebo was run). The three
  universe sets share coins and the period, so this is a third overlapping look, not an independent one.

Reading: the registered rule confirms k 1.20 on new 2023+ universes, with a thin maxDD margin and a CAGR gain whose interval includes

CAGR on the Binance settings and raised the worst month to 26 %.
